title: VTC Events — Registrations — Decide — payload
description: A host decides a pending registration for an event in approval mode: approve it, which makes the registrant going (or waitlisted, where the event is full and keeps a waitlist), or decline it, with an optional note the registrant reads. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

note.description: Shown to the registrant on their registration. Plain text.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: `approve`: the registration becomes going, or waitlisted where the event is full and keeps a waitlist. `decline`: the registration is declined; the registrant cannot re-open it.

Response.title: VTC Events — Registrations — Decide — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/registrations/decide/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/registrations/decide/0.2#response. A decline is a decision, answered here, never an error.

registration.description: The registration as it now stands: `going`, `waitlisted` or `declined`.
